title: MFSK Waveform
text: Multiple frequency shift keying (MFSK) continuous waveform, 1 output, {Output signal format} sets Output signal format; {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate 151e6, {Sweep bandwidth (Hz)} sets the mFSK sweep bandwidth 150e6, {Frequency step burst time (s)} sets the frequency step burst, {Number of steps per sweep} sets the total number of frequency steps, {Chirp offset frequency (Hz)} sets the chirp offset frequency -294e3, {Number of sweeps in output}, {Number of frequency steps in output}, {Number of samples in output} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Frequency step burst time (s)
params.values: Frequency step burst time 5e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Number of steps per sweep
params.values: Total number of frequency steps 512 (default) | even positive scalar

params.name: Output signal format
params.values: Output signal format Steps (default) | Samples | Sweeps

params.name: Number of sweeps in output
params.values: Number of sweeps in output 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of frequency steps in output
params.values: Number of frequency steps in output 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of samples in output
params.values: Number of samples in output 100 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
